visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a woman wearing a crown and heavy skeleton-themed special effects makeup on half her face, appearing in a dimly lit setting with colorful background lights. (2) The scene shifts to a brightly lit indoor studio where the woman's head is being wrapped in plastic wrap by a male professional wearing a mask and an apron labeled 'Bonnies'. (3) A green substance is applied to her face while she sits still in a stylist's cape; a male assistant and a female artist are visible in the background. (4) More layers of purple and white casting material are added, completely covering her facial features except for her nostrils. (5) A close-up shot shows the hardened white plaster mold on her face before she pulls it off, revealing the detailed inner impression. (6) A makeup artist uses fine brushes to paint a realistic skeleton jaw and eye socket design on the woman's face, incorporating shiny gemstones for detail. (7) The woman is then seen in a high-fashion black cutout dress, posing in front of a red velvet curtain and a large ornate mirror, holding the prosthetic face mask. (8) A man in a black cap is seen interacting with the realistic prosthetic mask, examining it closely and joking with the woman.
